definitions.gloss: interior finishing material; interior trim material
definitions.explanation: Materials used to finish the inside of a building or vehicle, such as wall coverings, flooring, and ceiling panels, as distinct from structural or exterior materials.

examples.japanese: {内装材|ないそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内装材|ないそうざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。

⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内装材|ないそうざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧や⟦{質感|しつかん}→質感：18028_shitsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: A room's atmosphere changes greatly depending on the color and texture of the interior materials.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{内装|ないそう}→内装：06425_naisou⟧ (interior fittings, interior decoration) + ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (material). Used in construction, renovation, and car-customization contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内装材|ないそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り{替|か}える→張り替える：28418_harikaeru⟧: to replace the interior materials
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内装材|ないそうざい}: wooden interior materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外装材|がいそうざい}→外装材：26745_gaisouzai⟧: exterior material — the counterpart used for the outside of a building
- ⟦{建材|けんざい}→建材：12646_kenzai⟧: building material — a broader term covering all materials used in construction
